The purpose of the training is to establish a consistent baseline level of AI literacy across the sector and provide staff with the knowledge required to understand AI, recognise the responsibilities associated with its use, and use AI appropriately and responsibly within a public-service environment. This reflects the current sector approach of providing a universal AI literacy baseline separately from practical tool-specific enablement. Section I: Program Overview & Background 1.1 Purpose The Department of the Air Force (DAF), Business and Enterprise Systems (BES) Directorate, AFLCMC/GBGD, is issuing this Commercial Solutions Opening (CSO) to identify and acquire an innovative, commercially available Digital Adoption Platform (DAP). This platform will replace the legacy Oracle User Productivity Kit (UPK), which is reaching its official end-of-life. The primary goal of this acquisition is to secure a modern, sustainable, enterprise-ready so

User Productivity Kit (UPK), which is reaching its official end-of-life. The primary goal of this acquisition is to secure a modern, sustainable, enterprise-ready software-guided training and performance-support tool. It must streamline content creation, simplify software adoption, and provide real-time in-application guidance for the DEAMS user base. 1.2 Mission Impact & Capability Gap The current solution (Oracle UPK) represents unsupported software and significant technical debt. Its retirement creates a critical operational gap in how training is conducted across the enterprise. The replacement DAP will modernize training material outputs, provide interactive in-application assistance, and reduce the overall training footprint. This capability is designated as a Criticality (1) — Must Have requirement to support continuous financial and enterprise operations. 1.3 Scope of the Target Environment • User Base: Approximately 26,000+ geographically dispersed personnel across 170+ global locations. • Primary Integration: Stable and proven integration with Oracle e-Business Suite (EBS) (including F orms & OAF pages) and modern web applications. • Target Environments: The DAP must be deployable and tested across both Development (Dev) and Test environments before transitioning to

The current legacy analog infrastructure limits scalability, resilience, and interoperability. Under this Call for Solutions, the selected vendor will deliver, integrate, install, and acceptance-test a flexible, open-standard, modular Digital IF solution across up to twenty (20) worldwide satellite communications (SATCOM) teleport sites. Increment 1 will establish a fully operational baseline designed to support subsequent capability upgrades and integrations in future fiscal years. SECTION 2 – REQUIREMENT DESCRIPTION PROBLEM STATEMENT Area of Interest: Modular Digital Intermediate Frequency Solu

quires an open-standard Digital IF architecture. However, before committing to a full-scale global deployment, the DoW must validate the operation, interoperability, security, and performance of these modular commercial solutions in a rigorous representative environment. Technical Objective & Scope The DoW seeks a commercial solution for an Increment 1 Digital IF capability set built on a flexible, open standard (e.g., Digital Intermediate Frequency Interoperability compliant), modular architecture. The selected solution will undergo standard site acceptance testing and operational verification to confirm compliance with contract performance requirements and site compatibility. Upon successful acceptance, this operational configuration will serve as the standardized baseline for deployment and installation across up to twenty (20) worldwide SATCOM teleport sites. Mission Impact Successful validation and deployment of this flexible open-standard Digital IF architecture will directly enhance warfighter lethality and survivability by delivering a highly resilient, agile, and survivable GEO-SATCOM capability which rapidly adapts to contested/congested environments.
